channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Video captures Russian attack in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia
item.description: Surveillance camera video captured the moment a Russian drone strike caused a blast in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine.

item.title: Iran conflict: Why has oil stayed near $100 a barrel?
item.description: The worst-case oil scenario has been avoided, but inflation and slower growth continue to weigh on the global economy.

item.title: Iran says US has revoked World Cup ticket allocation for their supporters
item.description: Iranian players and support staff got US visas and landed in Mexico on Sunday for the World Cup, but now fans in doubt.

item.title: Trump says Iran deal in ‘final throes’
item.description: Donald Trump said that he's in the 'final throes' of a deal with Iran.

item.title: Iran war day 102: Trump warns Israel against new strikes as ceasefire holds
item.description: Iran warns fighting could restart as tensions remain high and Trump urges Israel to protect the fragile ceasefire.

item.title: Iran’s lakes are vanishing: Satellite images show a deepening water crisis
item.description: Years of drought, falling rainfall and unsustainable water use have been worsened further by the US-Israel war.

item.title: Trump tells BBC Netanyahu did not defy him
item.description: In a call with the US president, the BBC’s Sarah Smith asked Trump about the war in Iran and his relationship with the Israeli leader.

item.title: Israel and Iran flare-up could strengthen Tehran's negotiating hand
item.description: Iran appears emboldened by the outcome and its leaders may sense Trump's appetite for risk is low.

item.title: Man accused of killing mother-in-law with poison-laced satay
item.description: Indonesia police allege the man killed the woman as he felt disrespected by her.

item.title: Tickets for Iran fans revoked, says federation
item.description: Iran's football federation says its allocation of tickets for the group stage of the World Cup has been revoked just days before the tournament.
